# Research log

Each investigation gets its own folder here: `research/<slug>/` with the plan in `plan.md`, one file
per source in `sources/`, and the synthesis in `00-SUMMARY.md`. A claim only reaches a wiki page if it
is recorded in [`../index/claims.json`](../index/claims.json) with a type and a source.
